title: Kyler Murray joins Vikings, whom 2-time Pro Bowl QB grew up rooting for, following release by Cardinals

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyler Murray joins Vikings, whom 2-time Pro Bowl QB grew up rooting for, following release by Cardinals
sources.description: Murray inked a one-year deal that includes a no-tag clause, which will allow him to hit free agency next year, according to multiple reports.
